func TestSendCommand_CreatesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	args := []string{"send", "--from", "kyle", "--to", "alex", "--subject", "Test", "--priority", "high", "--type", "request", "--body", "Hello"}

	err := run(context.Background(), args, db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	var msg inbox.Message
	err = db.First(&msg, "from = ? AND to = ?", "kyle", "alex").Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "Test", msg.Subject)
	assert.Equal(t, "high", msg.Priority)
	assert.Equal(t, "request", msg.Type)
	assert.Equal(t, "Hello", msg.Body)
}

func TestSendCommand_MissingRequiredFlags(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	args := []string{"send", "--to", "alex", "--subject", "Test"}

	err := run(context.Background(), args, db)
	assert.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "missing required flag: --from")
}

func TestListCommand_ShowsUnreadMessages(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	agent := "mike"

	msg1 := inbox.Message{ID: uuid.New(), From: "alice", To: agent, Subject: "Sub1", Archived: false}
	msg2 := inbox.Message{ID: uuid.New(), From: "bob", To: agent, Subject: "Sub2", Archived: false}
	msg3 := inbox.Message{ID: uuid.New(), From: "charlie", To: agent, Subject: "Sub3", Archived: true}

	err := db.Create(&msg1).Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&msg2).Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&msg3).Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	// Capture stdout
	oldStdout := os.Stdout
	r, w, _ := os.Pipe()
	os.Stdout = w

	args := []string{"list", "--agent", agent}
	err = run(context.Background(), args, db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	w.Close()
	os.Stdout = oldStdout

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	_, _ = io.Copy(&buf, r)
	output := buf.String()

	assert.Contains(t, output, "Sub1")
	assert.Contains(t, output, "Sub2")
	assert.NotContains(t, output, "Sub3")
}

func TestArchiveCommand_ArchivesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	msgID := uuid.New()
	msg := inbox.Message{ID: msgID, From: "alice", To: "bob", Subject: "Archive Me", Archived: false}
	err := db.Create(&msg).Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	args := []string{"archive", "--id", msgID.String()}
	err = run(context.Background(), args, db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	var updatedMsg inbox.Message
	err = db.First(&updatedMsg, "id = ?", msgID).Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, updatedMsg.Archived)
}

func TestWatchCommand_ExitsOnContext(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel() // Cancel immediately

	args := []string{"watch"}
	err := run(ctx, args, db)
	
	// Since handleWatch returns ctx.Err() when ctx.Done() is closed,
	// and we cancelled it, it should return context.Canceled.
	// The requirement says "verify it exits cleanly".
	assert.ErrorIs(t, err, context.Canceled)
}
